title: caesalpinia pinnata subsp. oblongifolia
intro: Caesalpinia pinnata subsp. oblongifolia, commonly known as the Kabong tree, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antidiabetic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the Kabong tree include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antibacterial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its health benefits include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential medicinal applications.
